newsitem.title: USA: Noble starts African LPG production.
newsitem.headline: Noble starts African LPG production.

text.p: Noble Affiliates Inc said Wednesday production has started from the LPG plant constructed in Equatorial Guinea.
The plant utilizes natural gas from the Alba field in which the company owns a 35 percent working interest.
Initial production rate from the plant is 1,700 barrels of LPG per day, plus recovery of an additional 400 barrels of condensate per day from the gas stream.
The plant is designed to produce approximately 2,400 barrels of LPG per day.
The LPG price is about $0.42 per gallon for the January production.
The company has a 33.25 percent revenue interest in the plant until payout of investment, at which time the interest will decrease to 28 percent.
